notes.title: Update notes for Aug 20
notes.content:
Bug fixes and performance enhancements:
* Hotseat now works properly
* Fixed enemy targeting issues when FoW is removed
* Fixed issue where "data" folder would not be present during update
* Fixed occasional hangups if AI players started first

notes.title: Campaign demo is now live!
notes.content:
You can now play the first mission of Nusantara's Campaign! It uses a short turn length to emulate quick real-time combat. Please check it out and let us know how you liked it, as that will affect how the rest of the campaign is built!

We also made a few bug fixes and added support for ultrawide screens.

notes.title: Update notes for Apr 23
notes.content:
* Added the option to toggle between Full Screen and Windowed mode
* Alt+Enter now allows for resizeable Windowed mode
* Fixed resolution changes in Windowed mode
